name: agy
description: Antigravity (agy) Plugin for Codex. Delegate code reviews, investigations, and tracked tasks to Gemini via the Antigravity CLI from inside Codex.

interface.longDescription: Use the Antigravity CLI (agy) from inside Codex to run read-only reviews, adversarial design reviews, and tracked rescue tasks against Gemini through a local, pre-authenticated agy binary, with job status and result retrieval.
defaultPrompt: Use Antigravity to review my current changes through $agy:review
Use Antigravity to challenge this implementation through $agy:adversarial-review
Use Antigravity to investigate and fix this issue through $agy:rescue
